paragraphs: R' Hanina bar Atal. See the entry R' Hanina bar Aniel (ר״ח בר עניל).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The target abbreviation ר״ח is completed as Hanina from the immediately preceding heading, with the exact Hebrew retained. Atal (עטל) and Aniel (עניל) are distinct supplied patronymic forms with conventional English vowels; the notice does not resolve the irregularity. The personal-title component remains R'.
Earlier machine OCR had ר״ת and חגינא where the supplied notice has ר״ח and חנינא; that discrepancy is not resolved by a new image reading.
